memos.thesis_summary: Hyperscaler and enterprise capex on AI infrastructure remains above consensus through next 4 quarters, supporting datacenter revenue mix and margin durability versus CPU-only models.
memos.expected_driver: Institutional reallocations into AI enablers after earnings revisions; supply constraints keep pricing power elevated.
memos.market_mispricing: Street models assume capex flattening in H2; channel data suggests continued acceleration in accelerator orders.
memos.key_risks: Export controls; customer concentration; multiple compression if rates stay higher; competition from in-house silicon.
memos.invalidation_conditions: Two consecutive quarters of datacenter revenue growth below 10% YoY OR guide-down on capex from two top customers.
memos.valuation_case: Premium multiple justified only if growth sustains; compare EV/sales to historical band when growth decelerates.
memos.why_now: Post-earnings drift window; revisions trend still upward; technical trend intact vs SPY.

memos.thesis_summary: If policy rates peak and financial conditions ease, small caps with domestic revenue may outperform large-cap tech concentration.
memos.expected_driver: Passive and factor rebalancers rotating from mega-cap growth into broader participation indices.
memos.market_mispricing: Market prices prolonged recession; credit spreads already reflect severe stress relative to labor data.
memos.key_risks: Recession deeper than expected; regional bank stress; liquidity gaps in small caps.
memos.invalidation_conditions: IWM underperforms SPY by >8% over 3 months while real rates rise OR credit spreads widen sharply.
memos.valuation_case: Relative valuation vs large caps at historical wide spread; requires catalyst not just cheapness.
memos.why_now: Breadth improving in recent rally attempts; monitoring rate-sensitive leadership.

memos.thesis_summary: Revenue grows if capex continues for two quarters because enterprises must spend.
memos.invalidation_conditions: If revenue falls two quarters, exit
